name: Pumpkit
description: Reviews Pumpkit hosted MCP tools that publish on the user's X account, queue or change a post that publishes later without another prompt, or delete a Scheduled post. Drafting, revising and read tools keep Guard's usual handling. Off until you turn it on.
saferAlternatives: Pumpkit's server instructions already ask the agent to show the exact text of every Part and get an explicit yes before post_now; keep post_now on Review so that holds even when the agent skips it.

schedule_post and edit_scheduled_post publish at the chosen time with no further prompt, and a new time retries a Failed post; keep them on Review so the person approves the text and time when it is queued.
Call list_scheduled_posts or get_post first; they are read-only and show what is queued and each Version's Final.
Drafting with start_post and give_feedback only writes Versions inside Pumpkit and publishes nothing on X.
